text:
Leah Park: Hi all — accepted the Redwood org invite but I can't see the repo I'm assigned to (redwood-inference/private-starters). Web shows org membership but repo 404s. Is this normal?

Evan (DevEx): Welcome Leah! Some repos are restricted and require an explicit repo-level invite in addition to org membership. Did you get a separate repo invite email?

Leah Park: I only got one email for the org invite. Nothing else in my inbox.

Maya (Hiring Manager): We sometimes keep early feature repos locked until first-day briefings. @Evan can you check if Leah needs a repo invite?

Evan (DevEx): Checking... Looks like private-starters is set to "Restricted" and grants access only to the "new-hires-2026" team. Your account shows as "Member" but you're not yet in that team. I'll add you manually unless you prefer waiting for the day-1 onboarding batch.

Leah Park: Manual add please — I'd like to poke at the README and set up my dev env tonight.

IT Bot: Reminder: Org policy requires 2FA. If you haven't enabled it, go to https://github.com/settings/security.

Leah Park: 2FA is enabled (auth app).

Evan (DevEx): Added you to team `new-hires-2026` and invited you to the repo. You should get a repo invite now — accept while signed into your work account. If you don't see it, check https://github.com/notifications and also look for a banner on the repo page.

Leah Park: I accepted the repo invite. I can see the README and clone works: `git clone git@github.com:redwood-inference/private-starters.git`. Thanks!

Maya (Hiring Manager): Great — FYI we use CODEOWNERS for early PR routing, so you'll be auto-requested reviewers from the onboarding team.

Leah Park: One more small thing — I tried to fork the repo but the UI says "Forking disabled for this repository". Is that expected?

Evan (DevEx): Yes, that's expected for restricted repos. We block forks to public or personal accounts for security until artifacts are stable. If you need an isolated sandbox, we can create a private repo copy for you.

Leah Park: No need now, everything's fine. Appreciate the quick help.

Onboarding Bot: Onboarding checklist updated: Repo access confirmed.

Evan (DevEx): Welcome to Redwood, Leah :tada: If you want the starter issues, DM me and I'll drop the quickstart checklist and environment variables."
